input.prompt: Painted 3D pop-art comic illustration, like a high-end modern American comic book panel: physically modelled figure, face and materials lit by a hard warm key light and a cool rim light, then bold black ink contour lines (thick outer line, thin inner lines) and Ben-Day halftone dots only inside the shadows, saturated colours. The man from the reference image stands on the left third of the picture, three-quarter view, holding up high in one hand a large blank golden foil ticket with scalloped edges, its face flat toward the viewer, catching the light. Behind him and to the right a huge modelled green graphics-processor chip lies like a city block at night, gold pins along its edges, its four square dies glowing warm, green light rising from the circuit traces, rain falling. Dark ink-blue night sky at the top, empty, calm. Keep the character's face, hair, black visor and leather jacket exactly as in the reference image. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no symbols on anything.
